text: Dainese is 100% owned by HPS Investment Partners and Arcmont Asset Management following a 30 million euro investment deal, announced on 29 January 2026.
short: Dainese is 100% owned by HPS Investment Partners and Arcmont Asset Management.

source.name: MCN (Motorcycle News): Dainese announce new owners after €30m investment deal approved
source.quote: they are now 100% owned by HPS Investment Partners and Arcmont Asset Management
source.note: MCN reports the deal was completed after European Commission antitrust approval; the two firms had invested in Dainese in October 2025 while it was owned by Carlyle.
